_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: kind: config — declarative booking email template registry. Adds three schemas (BookingConfirmationTemplate, BookingReminderTemplate, BookingCancellationTemplate) each with draft → published → archived lifecycle per ADR-031, declarative variable substitution and validation via x-openregister-calculations, branding customization (logo, accent, footer), and OR notification-engine dispatch wiring per ADR-022. Includes 6 seed templates (Dutch + English locales for each of the three template types). No PHP template service class — rendering and validation are declarative.

BookingConfirmationTemplate.title: Boekingsbevestigingssjabloon
BookingConfirmationTemplate.description: Branded email template dispatched immediately on booking confirmation. Carries subject and body fields with {{variables}} substituted at dispatch time by OR's notification engine, plain-text fallback for non-HTML clients, branding fields (logo URI, accent colour, footer) for per-template customization, and a draft → published → archived lifecycle. Variable substitution, subject length, and body size validation are declarative calculations (ADR-031); dispatch is consumed from OR's notification engine on booking.confirmed (ADR-022).

name.description: Human-readable template name shown in the admin list.
name.title: Name

status.description: Lifecycle state. draft = editable, not dispatched; published = active and dispatched on booking.confirmed; archived = retired, no new dispatches but kept for audit/history.
status.title: Status

locale.description: Template language (REQ-BET-NFR-005). nl = Dutch, en = English. The notification engine selects the matching locale at dispatch using the customer language preference, falling back to nl when no preference is set.
locale.title: Locale

subjectLine.description: Email subject. Limited to 78 characters for cross-client compatibility; supports {{variables}} substituted at dispatch.
subjectLine.title: Subject Line

htmlBody.description: HTML email body. Inline styles only — no external CSS, no JavaScript. Allowed elements limited to div, p, h1-h6, a, img, table, tr, td, ul, ol, li, br, span, strong, em. Combined html + plain-text size capped at 102 KB.
htmlBody.title: Html Body

plainTextBody.description: Plain-text fallback. Required for email clients without HTML rendering; supports {{variables}}.
plainTextBody.title: Plain Text Body

logoUri.description: URL of the organization logo image. Loaded from CDN or document-store URI — never inline base64 (keeps email size small and supports updates without resending).
logoUri.title: Logo URI

accentColor.description: Hex colour code for branding accents. Six-digit hex.
accentColor.title: Accent Color

footerText.description: Custom footer text — typically address, contact information, legal notices.
footerText.title: Footer Text

senderName.description: Display name used as the From: header at dispatch.
senderName.title: Sender Name

senderAddress.description: Email address used as the From: sender at dispatch.
senderAddress.title: Sender Address

activatedAt.description: Timestamp when the template was first published. Set on the first draft → published transition.
activatedAt.title: Activated At

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Editable, not yet dispatched. The default state for new templates and clones of published versions.

published.label: Gepubliceerd
published.description: Actively dispatched on booking.confirmed events. activatedAt is stamped at first transition into this state.

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Retired. No new dispatches; previously sent instances remain visible in history. Terminal state.

publish.label: Publiceren
publish.description: Activate the template for dispatch. Stamps activatedAt on first publish.

archiveDraft.label: Concept archiveren
archiveDraft.description: Archive a draft that never went live.

archivePublished.label: Archiveren
archivePublished.description: Retire an active template. No new dispatches after archive.

renderedSubjectPreview.expression: renderTemplate(@self.subjectLine, {customerName: 'Femke Jansen', bookingRef: 'BK20260521042', bookingDate: '22 mei 2026', bookingTime: '10:00', bookingLocation: 'Kantoor Amsterdam, Kamer 3', organizationName: 'Example BV'})
renderedSubjectPreview.description: Subject rendered with sample booking variables for operator validation (T16). Variables are substituted via {{variable}} syntax; undefined variables render as empty string (T14).

renderedBodyPreview.expression: renderTemplate(@self.plainTextBody, {customerName: 'Femke Jansen', bookingRef: 'BK20260521042', bookingDate: '22 mei 2026', bookingTime: '10:00', bookingLocation: 'Kantoor Amsterdam, Kamer 3', organizationName: 'Example BV'})
renderedBodyPreview.description: Plain-text body rendered with sample variables. Used by the admin preview surface; HTML preview is rendered identically by the manifest preview action.

subjectLineLength.description: Character count of the rendered subject (T12). Used by the admin UI to warn when substituted variables could push the subject past 78 characters.

totalBodySizeBytes.description: Combined HTML + plain-text body size in bytes (T13). Warns when approaching the 102 KB SMTP-safe ceiling.

htmlBodySafe.description: Whether the HTML body contains only whitelisted elements with inline styles (T11). External CSS (<link>, <style>), JavaScript (<script>), and unsupported tags fail validation.

fallback.description: On render failure or missing HTML body fall back to plain-text dispatch; log error for operator review (T21).

onBookingConfirmed.description: Declarative email dispatch consumed from OR's notification engine (ADR-022). When booking.confirmed fires, the engine selects a published template matching the recipient locale, renders subject + html + plain-text with booking variables, and dispatches through the configured email provider — no direct SMTP from app code. Render failure falls back to plain-text (T21) and is logged for operator review.

x-openregister-rbac.description: Template administration is restricted to the template-administrator role (full CRUD), booking-administrator (read/update), and auditor (read-only) per T22. Permission slugs map onto OR CRUD permissions; publish is modelled as an update of the status field gated by the lifecycle state machine.

BookingReminderTemplate.title: Boekingsherinneringssjabloon
BookingReminderTemplate.description: Branded email template dispatched a configurable number of hours before booking start. Carries hoursBeforeBooking timing, subject/body with {{variables}}, plain-text fallback, branding, and the same draft → published → archived lifecycle as the confirmation template. Multiple reminder templates can coexist (e.g. 24h and 2h) — the notification engine schedules one dispatch per published reminder per booking.

name.description: Human-readable template name shown in the admin list.
name.title: Name

status.description: Lifecycle state. Same semantics as BookingConfirmationTemplate.
status.title: Status

hoursBeforeBooking.description: Hours before booking start to dispatch the reminder. Common values: 1, 2, 24, 48, 72. OR's notification engine schedules dispatch at bookingStart − hoursBeforeBooking hours with a ±15 min tolerance; missed windows dispatch immediately.
hoursBeforeBooking.title: Hours Before Booking

htmlBody.description: HTML body; inline styles only; whitelisted elements; combined html + plain-text ≤102 KB.
htmlBody.title: Html Body

logoUri.description: Organization logo URI; loaded from CDN/doc-store; never inline base64.
logoUri.title: Logo URI

senderName.description: Display name used as the From: header at dispatch.
senderName.title: Sender Name

published.description: Scheduled by the notification engine for active dispatch.

publish.description: Activate the template. Stamps activatedAt on first publish.

archiveDraft.description: Archive a draft that never went live.

onBookingReminderDue.description: Reminder dispatch consumed from OR's notification engine. The engine derives the dispatch time as bookingStart − scheduleOffsetHours; missed windows (e.g. activation after the scheduled time) dispatch immediately. Render failure falls back to plain-text and is logged for operator review (T21).

BookingCancellationTemplate.title: Boekingsannuleringssjabloon
BookingCancellationTemplate.description: Branded email template dispatched when a booking is cancelled. Carries the standard subject/body/branding fields plus a cancellationReasonRequired flag that exposes {{cancellationReason}} as an available template variable; otherwise identical to the confirmation template shape. Lifecycle is draft → published → archived.

htmlBody.description: HTML body; inline styles only; whitelisted elements.
htmlBody.title: Html Body

accentColor.description: Hex colour code for branding accents.
accentColor.title: Accent Color

cancellationReasonRequired.description: When true, {{cancellationReason}} is included in the template variable map at dispatch. When false, the variable resolves to empty string per the standard substitution rule (T14).
cancellationReasonRequired.title: Cancellation Reason Required

senderName.description: Display name used as the From: header at dispatch.
senderName.title: Sender Name

published.label: Gepubliceerd
published.description: Active and dispatched on booking.cancelled events.

publish.description: Activate the template; stamp activatedAt on first publish.

archiveDraft.description: Archive a draft that never went live.

onBookingCancelled.description: Cancellation dispatch consumed from OR's notification engine. When cancellationReasonRequired is true the engine injects the booking's cancellation reason into the variable map; otherwise {{cancellationReason}} resolves to empty string per the standard undefined-variable rule (T14).
